content:
harry: Following up on INF-3187 postmortem  noted a cluster-level NTP drift causing token `iat` failures + a couple of codepaths missing resource fields in audit logs. We need concrete owners, short timelines, and an action to detect recurrence automatically.

maya: Thanks for pulling this together. Priority: 1) fix token validation tolerance and flag rollout, 2) fill audit log scopes, 3) nightly secrets TTL verification, 4) recurrence monitoring + weekly digest.

sam: I'll pick up token validation. Plan: raise tolerance from 2s->5s, add unit + integration tests, and gate behind a runtime feature flag for 14d. Will open INF-3215 and a PR today. ETA: PR + tests by Friday EOD.

olivia: I'll own the audit logging gaps. I'll add scoped logging for the affected handlers, create an integration that asserts resource fields present, and update the runbook steps. Creating INF-3216 now. Target: next Wednesday.

infra-bot: Created INF-3215 (token-validation-tolerance) and INF-3216 (audit-scope-coverage). Linked both to INF-3187.

harry: For secrets rotation issues we had one service token expire and rollbacks were clumsy. Need an automation that alerts when KV TTL < X and a quick playbook to rotate. Any volunteers?

olivia: I can draft the playbook (manual steps + CLI commands) quickly. Will push to docs and link it in INF-3187.

sam: For automation, propose a small scheduled job that queries SecretsStore and emits a ticket when TTL < 7d. I don't have cycles this week; can someone from infra take it?

maya: @harry can you or infra team pick the automation? We should treat it as high priority.

harry: I'll take automation ownership. Will spawn INF-3217 (ttl-watcher), aim for a v1 that posts to #incidents and creates a ticket when <7d. ETA: 5 business days.

infra-bot: INF-3217 created: ttl-watcher-nightly.

sam: Back to monitoring: suggest two signals: (A) sudden uptick of auth 5xxs on /v1/auth (5m window) and (B) ratio of token-validation failures to successful auth attempts > 0.02 in 10m. I can draft Prom queries and alerts once PR merges.

olivia: Also add an automated weekly digest that surfaces any authz anomalies from the last 7 days and links to relevant tickets. Ops can review during the Monday sync.

maya: Good. Let's capture owners & due dates in INF-3187 checklist: token fix -> sam (Fri EOD), audit scopes -> olivia (Wed next week), ttl-watcher -> harry (5 business days), monitoring rules + digest -> sam + ops (post-PR). I'll update the ticket now.

harry: One more operational note: the root cause traces showed one host with 300ms NTP jitter. We should add an ntp_sync metric and a remediation step in the runbook (drain + reprovision) if jitter > 50ms for > 10m.

sam: Agreed. I'll add ntp_sync to the telemetry change in the token PR and the feature flag rollout notes will include a canary in infra region-1.

olivia: Runbook update draft is ready and linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ab12cd3. It includes the ntp check and the audit verification step. Marking INF-3216 in progress.

infra-bot: INF-3187 checklist updated with assignees and due dates.

maya: Scheduling: can someone calendar a 30-min follow-up in two weeks to review whether the pattern recurred and whether the feature-flag rollback was clean?

harry: I can schedule a 30-min slot two weeks out and invite platform, sec-eng, and ops.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/630  includes tests + feature flag. Marking INF-3215 as in review.

olivia: Audit tests pushed as branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/compare/audit-scope-fix. Will open PR after some infra mocks.

maya: Thanks all. Please update INF-3187 when you close items (include PR/ticket links). Keeping this thread as the single aftercare tracker for now. :thumbsup:
